property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee that succeeds on its low-level calls, C.transfer(...) always completes and returns true; the mutant returns false for the same completing calls, so asserting that successful calls return true distinguishes them.
change_summary: Change the function to return the negation of the original constant true by returning '!true' (i.e., false), altering observable return value while execution proceeds as before.
